content:
Track: Introduction to Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Understanding Data Analysis and its Importance
    - Lesson 2: Overview of Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 3: Setting Up a Python Environment
    - Lesson 4: Introduction to Jupyter Notebooks
    - Lesson 5: Basics of NumPy and Pandas
    - Lesson 6: Reading, Writing, and Manipulating CSV Files
    - Lesson 7: Data Cleaning Techniques
    - Lesson 8: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) using EDA Tools
    - Lesson 9: Introduction to Statistics for Data Analysis

   Track: SQL Fundamentals
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to Relational Databases
    - Lesson 11: Creating and Managing Tables
    - Lesson 12: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
    - Lesson 13: Joins (INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, OUTER)
    - Lesson 14: Where, Having, and Group By Clauses
    - Lesson 15: Aggregations (SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, COUNT)
    - Lesson 16: Subqueries and Common Table Expressions (CTEs)
    - Lesson 17: Transactions and Constraints

   Track: Data Visualization with Matplotlib
    - Lesson 18: Intro to Matplotlib and Line Charts
    - Lesson 19: Bar and Histograms
    - Lesson 20: Scatter Plots and Bivariate Analysis
    - Lesson 21: Boxplots and Whisker Plots
    - Lesson 22: Heatmaps and Contour Plots
    - Lesson 23: Customizing and Annotating Plots
    - Lesson 24: Building Complex Multiple Subplots

   Track: Data Visualization with Seaborn
    - Lesson 25: Overview of Seaborn Library
    - Lesson 26: Styling and Customizing Visualizations
    - Lesson 27: Distplot and Kdeplot for Density Analysis
    - Lesson 28: Regression and Scatter Plot Matrix
    - Lesson 29: Clusterplots, Heatmaps, and Pairplots
    - Lesson 30: Building Interactive Visualizations with Bokeh or Plotly

   Track: Introduction to Power BI
    - Lesson 31: Setting Up Power BI Desktop
    - Lesson 32: Connecting to Data Sources
    - Lesson 33: Querying and Transforming Data
    - Lesson 34: Creating Visualizations in Power BI
    - Lesson 35: Building Interactive Dashboards
    - Lesson 36: Sharing and Publishing Power BI Reports

   Track: Excel for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 37: Overview of Excel for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 38: Basic Formulas and Functions
    - Lesson 39: Pivot Tables and Pivot Charts
    - Lesson 40: Conditional Formatting and What-if Analysis
    - Lesson 41: Advanced Filtering Techniques
    - Lesson 42: Data Validation and Protection
    - Lesson 43: Creating Dashboards in Excel
